caption: The drawing features a lace or embroidery design on an off-white or beige background. The design is composed of a curved, scalloped edge running from the lower left to the upper right, marked by small circular motifs along its border. At each end of the scalloped border, there is a cluster of circular forms arranged in a honeycomb-like pattern. Within the curve, there is a central diamond shape outlined by small circles, with a flower-like circular shape at its center. There are three additional smaller, flower-like circular motifs scattered symmetrically inside the curve, each with radiating petal patterns. The design makes use of white and pale gray lines and shading to create a sense of texture and dimensionality for the decorative elements. The entire composition is contained within a lightly drawn rectangle on the page, distinguishing the design from the blank surrounding space.
title: Eyelet Embroidery
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
